head: ONE HOOK LINE.
ONE AMBER LINE.
beats.text: Good day. My name is Presenter Name, and this film shows how the video kit turns a script into a finished film.

head: THREE
ROOT CAUSES.
beats.text: Every problem in a film is named as three causes. The first cause appears as you say it. The second follows. And the third completes the set.

head: QUICK QUESTION:
WHICH ONE?
beats.question: Which one would you pick?
beats.text: Quick question. Which one would you pick? If you hesitated, so does everyone else.

head: THREE STEPS.
ONE PLAN.
beats.title: The plan
beats.text: The plan has three steps. A pilot, then a roll-out, then we scale.

head: ONE NUMBER
WITH A SOURCE.
beats.label: A sourced figure
beats.text: Every number counts up as it is spoken, with its source on screen: 62 per cent.

head: SAY THE
ASK.
beats.text: End on the one thing you want the viewer to do. Thank you.
